entries.decision: Concorda and Prose are separate repositories; Concorda focuses on consumer-first Rose Mirror MVP.
Privacy-first Rose Mirror foundation package was integrated into main by PR #3, with further implementation and independent domain validation outstanding.

Deliver an offline, deterministic, synthetic-fixture-only Rose Mirror HTML/JSON preview with schema, safety gating, consent and HTML escaping checks. This is not a real-user product or independently validated relationship safety analysis.
Require verifiable consent, privacy, safety and independent review evidence before presenting an experience as pilot-ready.
Professional clinician-facing product functionality is deferred; it is not part of the consumer-first Rose Mirror MVP.
